groups.label: Nouns & Plurals
groups.definition: Rules for forming plural nouns from singular forms across regular and irregular categories.
rules: Nouns ending in -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z: add -es (bus -> buses, watch -> watches).
Nouns ending in consonant + -y: change to -ies (city -> cities).
Irregulars: man -> men, woman -> women, child -> children, person -> people, foot -> feet, tooth -> teeth, sheep -> sheep.

groups.label: Possessive Nouns ('s vs s')
groups.definition: Expressing ownership or connection using possessive apostrophe 's or of.
rules: Singular nouns: add 's (John's car, my mother's house).
Regular plural nouns: add ' (my parents' room).
Irregular plural nouns: add 's (the children's toys).
Inanimate objects: use 'of' (the door of the house).
